title: Set up an AI receptionist
blurb: Create a voice agent that greets callers, answers questions and takes details.

steps.title: Open AI Agents
steps.body: Click **AI Agents** in the left menu.

steps.title: Pick a starting point
steps.body: Choose a template such as **Front Desk Receptionist**, or **Create Custom Agent** to start blank. The template is the easy path.

steps.title: Name, voice and language
steps.body: Name the agent, pick a voice you like, and set the language to English. Play the samples first.

steps.title: Write the greeting
steps.body: Set the welcome message callers hear, like: "Kia ora, you have reached Smith Plumbing. How can I help today?" Keep it short.

steps.title: Tell it how to behave
steps.body: In the instructions, list what it should do (take name, address and job details) and what it must not do (quote prices, promise times).

steps.title: Connect your knowledge base and save
steps.body: Attach your knowledge base so it can answer questions about services, areas and hours, then click **Save**.
steps.tip: Next, set its hours, actions and phone number. Each has its own guide.
